run_benchmark_sam2_video_predictor: run the SAM 2 video predictor benchmark script to measure FPS for frame propagation tracking
build_sam2_video_predictor: build a SAM 2 video predictor using build_sam2_video_predictor with a model config and checkpoint path
init_predictor_state: initialize the predictor inference state with a video directory path using predictor.init_state
add_points_to_predictor: add positive click points to the predictor using predictor.add_new_points_or_box with frame index and object id
propagate_tracking_in_video: run frame-by-frame object tracking propagation across all video frames using predictor.propagate_in_video
